Shell(git add -A && git commit -F - <<'EOF' fix: "Hari Ini"/"Kemarin" laporan filter showing wrong data Date-only strings ("YYYY-MM-DD") passed to new Date() parse as UTC midnight, but the transaction/expense comparison dates were built in local time — shifting the whole range by the UTC offset (7 hours in Indonesia). "Hari Ini" excluded most of the day's transactions and "Kemarin" assigned them to the wrong day. Fix getTransactionsByDateRange and getExpensesByDateRange to build both range bounds in local time, matching how transaction dates are stored and compared. Added a regression test covering mixed local and legacy-ISO dates. Co-authored-by: CommandCodeBot <noreply@commandcode.ai> EOF echo "=== committed ===" && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -3)
